opportunities.title: Portfolio launch-wave enablement across recent FDA approvals
opportunities.what_happened: GSK secured a dense cluster of US FDA approvals across oncology, respiratory, vaccines and anti-infectives, including Blenrep, Nucala for eosinophilic COPD, expanded Arexvy, Penmenvy and Blujepa.
opportunities.evidence: FDA approved Blenrep (belantamab mafodotin-blmf) with bortezomib and dexamethasone; DREAMM-7 showed 51% reduction in risk of death
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Concurrent multi-brand launches likely exceed internal commercial and medical capacity, creating demand for scalable outsourced delivery.
opportunities.so_what: Multiple simultaneous launches concentrate a large, time-sensitive commercialization workload that Company can absorb.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: This is a multi-service opening across MedComm, MLR, Omnichannel and Regulatory ops to support several near-simultaneous launches under one scalable engagement.
opportunities.next_best_action: Present a cross-brand launch-wave delivery model quantifying capacity and speed benefits across the approved portfolio.
opportunities.if_no_action: Each approved brand builds its own support roster, and GSK absorbs the coordination burden. The cross-brand capacity case is never presented, so the wave lands on existing agencies.
opportunities.why_now: The approval cluster is recent, and cross-portfolio staffing decisions land this quarter.
opportunities.nba_outcome: Company presents a cross-brand launch-wave delivery model quantifying capacity and speed benefits.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Company wins scope on multiple approved brands under one scalable engagement. The cross-brand model becomes the template GSK uses to staff the next approval cluster.

opportunities.title: Nuvalent NSCLC integration and oncology launch support
opportunities.what_happened: GSK completed the $10.6bn Nuvalent acquisition, adding NSCLC assets zidesamtinib, neladalkib and NVL-330.
opportunities.evidence: Aggregate equity value approximately $10.6 billion (£8.0 billion); adds zidesamtinib, neladalkib and NVL-330 for NSCLC
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Integrating three oncology assets will require rapid buildout of medical, regulatory and commercial infrastructure that favors external partners.
opportunities.so_what: Post-close integration is the moment services demand spikes.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company MedComm, MLR and Regulatory can support the incoming NSCLC portfolio while DAAI integrates Nuvalent's data assets.
opportunities.next_best_action: Deliver an oncology-integration and launch-readiness proposal to GSK oncology commercial and medical leadership.
opportunities.if_no_action: Integration workloads go to partners already inside GSK while the architecture is being built. The medical, regulatory and commercial architecture gets fixed by whoever is engaged first, and late entry means retrofit work.
opportunities.why_now: The deal has closed, and integration architecture for the three assets is being built at its most open point now.
opportunities.nba_outcome: Company delivers an oncology-integration and launch-readiness proposal to GSK oncology leadership.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Medical, regulatory or data workstreams on the Nuvalent portfolio include Company this integration cycle.

opportunities.title: Bepirovirsen hepatitis B global launch readiness
opportunities.what_happened: Bepirovirsen achieved unprecedented functional cure rates in phase III and holds FDA priority review with an October 26, 2026 PDUFA date plus China review.
opportunities.evidence: NDA accepted for priority review, granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation; PDUFA goal date October 26, 2026
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: A potential first-in-class functional cure demands heavy medical education, payer engagement and high-volume promotional review across geographies.
opportunities.so_what: A hard PDUFA date sets an urgent launch-preparation timeline.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company Regulatory, MedComm, MLR and Omnichannel can support a global hepatitis B launch ahead of the October 2026 decision.
opportunities.next_best_action: Offer an integrated launch-readiness package aligned to the October 2026 PDUFA and China review timelines.
opportunities.if_no_action: The October 2026 PDUFA and China review drive readiness work with whichever partner engages first. Global launch content is built without Company's medical education and payer depth.
opportunities.why_now: October 26, 2026 locks the readiness timeline, and both the US and China decisions sit within it.
opportunities.nba_outcome: Company offers an integrated launch-readiness package aligned to the October 2026 PDUFA and China review timelines.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Company carries regulatory, MedComm, MLR and omnichannel workstreams for the global launch. Readiness assets are delivered ahead of the decision dates.

opportunities.title: Cost-efficiency partner for the £1.9bn savings program
opportunities.what_happened: GSK is targeting £1.9 billion in annual savings by 2029 to fund late-stage pipeline investment.
opportunities.evidence: £1.9 billion annual savings targeted by 2029 to fund late-stage portfolio investment
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: The savings mandate favors partners that can lower commercialization unit costs through scaled global delivery and AI automation.
opportunities.so_what: Cost pressure creates demand for efficiency-driven outsourcing.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company can position its global delivery and AI-enabled content/MLR automation as a direct contributor to GSK's savings target while preserving commercial reach.
opportunities.next_best_action: Build a quantified cost-takeout business case tied to GSK's 2029 savings goal.
opportunities.if_no_action: The savings program consolidates suppliers and squeezes rates while Company's cost case stays unquantified. Efficiency-driven work flows to partners who show their takeout in numbers.
opportunities.why_now: The 2029 savings goal is a standing commitment, and supplier consolidation under it is in execution now.
opportunities.nba_outcome: Company hands GSK a quantified cost-takeout business case tied to the 2029 savings goal.
opportunities.expected_outcome: Procurement references Company as a contributor to the £1.9bn program. Commercial scope survives rate consolidation because it carries a documented saving.

opportunities.title: Phase III expansion clinical-to-commercial enablement
opportunities.what_happened: GSK plans 20+ phase III trial starts in 2026, up from 10, with 7 asset accelerations across 18 indications.
opportunities.evidence: Expect 20+ phase III trial starts in 2026 (up from 10); 7 asset accelerations identified across 18 indications
opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Doubling phase III activity generates surging regulatory, medical-writing and data workloads plus a downstream launch pipeline.
opportunities.so_what: The expanded pipeline is a multi-year demand engine for services.
opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company Regulatory ops, DAAI and MedComm can scale with the phase III surge and pre-position for the resulting launch waves across 18 indications.
opportunities.next_best_action: Propose a flexible clinical-to-commercial capacity framework tied to the phase III expansion.
opportunities.if_no_action: The phase III surge is staffed without Company, and the resulting launch waves follow the same vendor map. The clinical work now and the commercial work later both pass Company by.
opportunities.why_now: The doubling of phase III starts happens in 2026, and capacity commitments for it are being placed this year.
opportunities.nba_outcome: GSK receives a flexible clinical-to-commercial capacity framework tied to the phase III expansion.
opportunities.expected_outcome: A standing role in the phase III surge is secured before the year ends. Company holds an early position on the launch waves those trials will generate.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: AI/data partnership gap versus Noetik-style collaborations
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: GSK licensed Noetik's AI foundation models for oncology in a $50m five-year deal for OCTO-VC virtual cell models in NSCLC and colorectal cancer.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: $50 million upfront five-year deal for Noetik OCTO-VC virtual cell models in NSCLC and colorectal cancer, trained on ~40 million cells
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: GSK's appetite for external AI capability suggests unmet demand for AI-enabled commercialization and data services that Company may not yet be capturing.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: If Company is absent from GSK's AI/data vendor landscape, a competitor may anchor the relationship.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company DAAI and Tech Solutions should proactively pitch AI-enabled commercial analytics and content to avoid ceding the AI narrative to specialized entrants.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Develop a GSK-specific DAAI/Tech Solutions AI offering and secure an executive meeting before competitors deepen their footprint.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: GSK's AI/data vendor landscape keeps filling with specialized entrants like Noetik. Company's absence from the AI narrative compounds, and commercial AI demand gets anchored by someone else.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The Noetik deal shows GSK's live appetite for external AI, and the commercial AI partner map is being drawn while that appetite is visible.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: Company develops a GSK-specific DAAI/Tech Solutions AI offering and secures an executive meeting.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Company appears in GSK's AI/data vendor conversations before the next vendor review. The commercial AI narrative is not ceded entirely to specialized entrants.

potential_missed_opportunities.title: Defending declining General Medicines with low-cost delivery
potential_missed_opportunities.what_happened: General Medicines declined 9% in Q2 2026 (down 6% in Q1) due to genericization of the older portfolio.
potential_missed_opportunities.evidence: General Medicines down 6% in Q1, driven by declining sales of the older established portfolio
potential_missed_opportunities.ai_hypothesis: Legacy-brand budgets are shrinking, so a failure to offer a compelling low-cost maintenance model risks Company missing this segment entirely.
potential_missed_opportunities.so_what: There is a narrow window to serve mature brands profitably before spend is cut further.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Company can capture efficiency-driven work by offering an ultra-low-cost omnichannel and content model for mature General Medicines brands.
potential_missed_opportunities.next_best_action: Design a lean maintenance-mode delivery tier for GSK's declining General Medicines portfolio.
potential_missed_opportunities.if_no_action: General Medicines spend is cut further, and Company captures none of the maintenance work. The efficiency-driven segment closes as budgets shift to Specialty and Vaccines.
potential_missed_opportunities.why_now: The portfolio is declining in current quarters, and each planning cycle narrows the window to serve it profitably.
potential_missed_opportunities.nba_outcome: Company designs a lean maintenance-mode delivery tier for the declining portfolio.
potential_missed_opportunities.expected_outcome: Company serves mature General Medicines brands profitably at a lower cost point. The maintenance segment is captured before further spend cuts.
